summary: Checks for this pass ran in headless Chromium 141 with the file opened from disk and networking disabled (tools/verify_design.cjs): the embedded self-test passed 15 of 15, 14 interaction checks passed, every visible text element met WCAG AA contrast at 1440 and 390 px with all disclosures open, and no page-wide horizontal overflow appeared from 320 to 1440 px. Screen-reader, Safari, Firefox and physical-device checks were not performed.
